messages:
alex: Morning — quick async standup from me. What I did: merged the route-expression change to staging and ran a few smoke tests. Blocker: seeing intermittent 429s from the dedicated pool when auth tokens are being rotated. Today: triage logs, add a short retry on 429 for the auth proxy, and follow up with infra about pool headroom. Ping me if you want to pair later. :coffee:
maria: Thanks — can you paste one of the failing request IDs? I can check the router logs and auth-proxy traces.
alex: Yep: req=stg-9f3a2e. Quick grep I ran: ```
grep "stg-9f3a2e" /var/log/gateway/router.log | tail -n 20
# shows 429 from auth-proxy then immediate retry from client
```
priya: Hmm that pattern usually means the token refresh path is slow. Which auth-provider are we hitting for staging?
alex: staging hits auth-vault-us-west via the pool. We started rolling jwt-rotation last night.
devin: I can throw a short patch that adds a 100ms jittered backoff on client-side retries for 429s to avoid tight thundering. Would help while we debug.
sam: +1 for a small client-side mitigation. Also, can we add a gauge in the console for auth-proxy request latency? Right now we only have p95s for gateway.
priya: Agree on metrics. I can add a dashboard tile for auth-proxy latency and 429 rate per pool — will do this afternoon.
alex: SG. Maria, did you see any correlation with route-expression changes? Could routing add extra header size that trips something?
maria: I checked header sizes quickly — nothing unusual. The spike aligns more with token rotation windows.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout complete: route-expr-change -> staging @ 2026-03-17T09:12:03Z :white_check_mark:
alex: Nice — thanks. Action items: 1) devin to open small PR for client 429 backoff, 2) priya to add auth-proxy latency/429 dashboard, 3) maria + alex to triage auth-proxy traces and correlate with token rotation windows.
sam: I'll owner the follow-up runbook if this repeats in prod. Also tagging @devops to eyeball dedicated pool headroom. :eyes:
priya: quick question re: alert thresholds — what threshold should trigger an ops paging? Current alert fires at 5% 429 across all pools for 5m. That's noisy for short rotation windows.
maria: Maybe set to 10% over 10m for now and put a temporary suppression around the rotation job windows.
alex: Good call. I'll update the ops ticket with proposed temporary thresholds.
sam: OK folks, leave any follow-ups in the ticket thread. I'll try to sync up at 17:00 if anyone's free to pair on the trace. :+1:
alex: Thanks all — will push the small client patch to staging once PR is up.
